frase_inicial: Samantha and kids: you already cover 7.9 months of living costs, and there’s a clear next step.

tarjetas.reverso: Ethan's and Ava's school costs will draw on your cash cushion; start by choosing which child’s payment to fund first so the cushion stays intact.
tarjetas.detalle: Ethan starts August 2026 with yearly college cost $12,500; Ava starts August 2028. Funding gap total $98,837.55.

tarjetas.frente: Retirement depends on savings that run out
tarjetas.reverso: Projection shows savings running out at age 73, so decide whether to direct some savings to retirement accounts now or later.
tarjetas.detalle: Savings and investments run out at age 73; guaranteed income covers 25% of retirement need.

tarjetas.frente: Home and car may lack recorded insurance
tarjetas.reverso: The plan flags homeowners and auto as showing uninsured; confirming coverage protects the house and car from a big bill.
tarjetas.detalle: Top move in plan: add homeowners insurance on Primary home to close coverage gap.

tarjetas.frente: Too much cash sits in taxable accounts
tarjetas.reverso: Some of your yearly saving goes to taxable accounts while tax-advantaged options are unused; looking into them can lower taxes and help retirement.
tarjetas.detalle: No retirement accounts listed; eligible for deductible IRA up to $7,500 and HSA up to $4,400 (if qualified).

tarjetas.frente: A single big holding concentrates your investments
tarjetas.reverso: Large position in one US-focused fund makes your stocks concentrated; spreading it reduces reliance on one market or sector.
tarjetas.detalle: VTI is ~39% of investable; plan suggests moving about $58,300 to reduce concentration.

movimientos.title: Close a coverage gap
movimientos.action: Add homeowners insurance on Primary home so coverage integrity clears that gap

movimientos.title: Reduce single-name concentration
movimientos.action: Bring VTI from 39% to 25% of investable for the next concentration band — about $58,300 of that line

movimientos.title: Reduce growth allocation toward glide
movimientos.action: Move the invested mix from 85% to 80% growth (glide 80%) for the next horizon-fit band — about $17,100 of the invested book

hitos.titulo: Confirm homeowners and auto insurance for your house and Porsche

mapa.aviso: Illustrative simulator: it shows the direction of change, not a Sherpas projection.

siguiente_paso.razon: The plan lists homeowners cover as the top move to close a coverage gap and it protects the large share of your wealth tied to the house.
pasos: Find the homeowner insurance policy number or the insurer email (check last year's bill or mortgage file).
Call or email your insurer and ask: is the Primary home listed and active?
If not covered, request an online quote and set up the policy to start today.
